relationship_features.definition: Past occurrences of the exact origin-destination pair, using only steps strictly before the current step.
relationship_features.finding: No train or validation row had an earlier occurrence of the same PaySim origin-destination pair, so both features were constant.

isolation_forest.training_policy: Prequential scores on training days; detector fitted on days 1-18 frozen for validation; no fraud labels used.
isolation_forest.finding: Small ranking gain but worse precision and recall at every reviewed daily top-k capacity.
